name: Cauliflower "Fried Rice" with Edamame, Mushrooms, Carrots & Peanuts
instructions: Wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with stir-fry sauce, miso paste, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower, edamame, mushrooms, and carrots; stir-fry until tender and warmed through, about 6 minutes.
Add sauce and peanuts to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower-edamame "fried rice" between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
